name: step3_functional_subspace_conflict_projection_v3_protocol
motivation: V2 improved refusal and procedural proxy markers but failed redirect and exact-response diversity because it deleted every risk update inside the safety functional subspace, including non-conflicting content directions.
frozen_change_from_v2: Within each LoRA-A safety functional subspace, apply a PCGrad correction to the risk-branch gradient only when its inner product with the paired safety-branch gradient is negative. Preserve aligned and orthogonal risk components, the complete safety gradient, basis-exterior components, and gradients accumulated before the microstep.
smoke_requirements: All losses and gradients are finite with zero skipped optimizer steps.
At least one protected-subspace conflict is observed and corrected.
Aggregate negative protected conflict after correction is at most 1e-5 of the value before correction plus numerical epsilon.
VRAM headroom is at least 10 percent.
pass_next_action: Run paired utility development evaluation only after every frozen safety gate passes.
failure_next_action: Stop FCP20 before 64 steps and heldout evaluation; preserve the null result without weakening the gate.
